brief: Describes an institution's adaptation of the core program, laid over it file by file, and judges it before it is used.
detail: An overlay is a folder with overlay.zknw (its name, the program it extends, the languages it speaks, its brand, the worlds it replaces) and optional worlds, courses and governance folders. It adds and shadows; it never forks the core: it may replace a world and add chapters and exercises, but a file that would replace a core chapter or a core exercise is refused. Check is its court and returns findings in the house shape; the overlay is valid when none is an error.
